{"answer":"
A runny nose and cough like this is most often a simple cold.
 
Colds usually improve within 7 to 10 days
, and 
the cough can last about a week, often after the other symptoms have gone.
 Eating and playing normally is a good sign.","triage":"Call 811 if it isn't improving after 10 days, or if there's ear pain, a high fever, or they're drinking much less. Go to the ER or call 911 now for trouble breathing, ribs pulling in, blue or dusky lips, or if they're very sleepy or hard to wake.","sources":["Boston Children's Hospital","KidsHealth (Nemours)"]}
